User.title: User
User.description: The user profile document which represents registered students in xchange.

major.description: Undergrad major, candidate department, or curriculum track

bio.description: Student bibliography, motivations and exchange notes

canTeach.description: Skills the student is qualified and eager to tutor

wantToLearn.description: Skills the student wants to pick up from other peers

tokens.description: Skill economy ledger balance inside the Xtoken wallet

avatarUrl.description: Personal profile avatar illustration or custom remote secure URL

qualification.description: Education level e.g. Undergraduate, Masters, etc.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents an automated financial or educational event inside the Xtoken wallet.

type.description: Earn credits for teaching vs Spend credits for booking

description.description: Particular explanation of the reciprocal swap session or welcome grant

date.description: Localized calendar record of the exchange

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: Shared educational files, books, video classes, or drafts posted inside the digital workspace.

/users/{userId}.description: Top-level collection for all user profiles

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: User specific wallet transactions audit trail

/resources/{resourceId}.description: Shared PDF assets and files accessible inside workspace pages
